# function: render

Renders a dashboard DSL document into the dashboard JSON of the target schema it resolves to, and returns it as a string. The function writes nothing: the caller puts the string where the UI loads it, such as the `content` of an `aws_s3_object` in a bucket the UI's file provider reads. The target schema is the call's `target_schema`, else the one the document's `target_schemas` leave; the provider's `default_target_schemas` apply only to the `dashboard_render` data source. The dashboard's name in the UI derives from `owner` and `name`, so the same pair replaces the same dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aws_s3_object" "mock_service_dashboard" {
  bucket       = "mock-config-bucket"
  key          = "grafana/dashboards/mock-owner/mock-service.json"
  content_type = "application/json"
  content = provider::dashboard::render(
    file("${path.module}/../../dashboards/mock-service.yml"),
    "mock-owner",
    "mock-service",
  )
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
render(spec string, owner string, name string, target_schema string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `spec` (String) The dashboard document's text.
1. `owner` (String) Who declares the dashboard.
1. `name` (String) The dashboard's name among its owner's.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `target_schema` (Variadic, String) The target schema to render for: a whole identifier, such as `grafana-v2-13`, or the leading words of one, such as `grafana`; at most one.
